tickets.title: Prepare side-by-side care option comparison
tickets.text: Prepare a side-by-side comparison for Harold and Lena Velvetreed covering in-home aide coverage, adult day programming, short respite stays, transportation, and likely out-of-pocket costs under several weekly care-hour levels. Use the neurologist's recommendation of 20 to 24 hours per week of in-home aide support and physical therapy twice weekly as the baseline care scenario.
tickets.evidence: Harold asked for a side-by-side view of in-home aide coverage, adult day programming, short respite stays, transportation, and likely out-of-pocket costs under several weekly care-hour levels; the agreed follow-up is to prepare that comparison by 2026-01-20.

tickets.title: Build family caregiver coverage map
tickets.text: Build a family caregiver coverage map for Harold and Lena Velvetreed showing Sofia Copperwisp's weekend availability (about one weekend per month overnight), Martin Velvetreed's remote medication refill role from Portland, Harold's fatigue, and gaps during weekday evenings. Reflect Lena's mobility limits following her 2025-12-18 fall and Parkinson's diagnosis.
tickets.evidence: Lena’s mobility limits changed the household routine, and the family described Sofia’s weekend availability, Martin’s remote medication role, Harold’s fatigue, and gaps during weekday evenings; the agreed follow-up is to build a family caregiver coverage map by 2026-01-16.

tickets.title: Prepare Silver Marmot claim-intake packet
tickets.text: Prepare the Silver Marmot Insurance claim-intake packet for Harold and Lena Velvetreed, organizing physician orders, care notes, aide agency estimates, invoices, and policy questions for the pending claim-intake appointment. Include both policies' 90-day elimination period details and the daily benefit maximums of $220 (Harold) and $180 (Lena).
tickets.evidence: Silver Marmot Insurance has a claim-intake appointment pending, and the family needs an organized packet of physician orders, care notes, aide agency estimates, invoices, and policy questions for that conversation; the agreed follow-up is to prepare the intake packet by 2026-01-12.

tickets.title: Resolve aide shift minimums in cost estimates
tickets.text: Reconcile the inconsistent aide shift minimums in the projected weekly care cost estimates for Harold and Lena Velvetreed, where one agency quote described a four-hour minimum for daytime shifts while Sofia Copperwisp's call notes showed three-hour visits. Confirm the correct minimum with each agency before finalizing the cost projections.
tickets.evidence: One agency quote described a four-hour minimum for daytime shifts, while Sofia’s call notes showed three-hour visits, creating inconsistent assumptions in the projected weekly care cost; the agreed follow-up is to resolve the aide shift minimums in the cost estimates by 2026-01-13.

tickets.title: Correct Lena's secure upload access
tickets.text: Correct Lena Velvetreed's secure upload access so she has a separate upload stream for care records, health forms, and aide invoices tied to her Silver Marmot Insurance claim file. The current portal invitation opened under Harold Velvetreed's login, blocking Lena's independent uploads.
tickets.evidence: Lena’s portal invitation opened under Harold’s login, preventing a separate upload stream for care records, health forms, and aide invoices tied to Lena’s claim file; the agreed follow-up is to correct secure upload access by 2026-01-09.

tickets.title: Address policy benefit inflation assumptions
tickets.text: Address the differing inflation rider language across Harold and Lena Velvetreed's two Silver Marmot Insurance long-term care policies in the care-cost projections. Show how each policy's inflation rider affects the daily benefit maximums of $220 (Harold) and $180 (Lena) over time.
tickets.evidence: Mira’s review found that the two Silver Marmot Insurance policies use different inflation rider language, which affects how the daily benefit maximums should be shown in the care-cost projections; the agreed follow-up is to address the policy benefit inflation assumptions by 2026-01-23.
